requirements.title: toolio Input Resolution and Forge-Neutral Issue Parsing
requirements.rationale: Tool input resolution must uniformly recognize and fetch issue and pull/merge request threads across both GitHub and GitLab forges.

criteria.action: define KindIssue SourceKind as "issue" and update Input struct fields to reference *issuex.IssueRef and *issuex.IssueThread
criteria.contract: KindIssue constant string value is "issue"; Input struct has Issue of type *issuex.IssueRef; Input struct has Thread of type *issuex.IssueThread

setup: the toolio package source code
check.pseudocode:
assert string(toolio.KindIssue) == "issue"
var in toolio.Input
var _ *issuex.IssueRef = in.Issue
var _ *issuex.IssueThread = in.Thread

criteria.condition: Resolve is called with an argument string matching a GitHub or GitLab issue or pull/merge request URL
criteria.action: parse the argument via issuex.ParseIssueURL and retrieve the issue thread using the provided issuex.Client
criteria.contract: GitHub issue URL resolves to KindIssue with matching owner, name, and issue number; GitLab merge request URL resolves to KindIssue with multi-segment owner, name, number, and IsPullRequest true; parsed thread contents are retrieved and populated on the Input struct

setup: a mock issuex.Client configured to return issue and pull/merge request threads
check.pseudocode:
inGH, errGH := toolio.Resolve(ctx, "https://github.com/org/repo/issues/42", nil, client)
assert errGH == nil && inGH.Kind == toolio.KindIssue
assert inGH.Issue.Repo.Owner == "org" && inGH.Issue.Repo.Name == "repo" && inGH.Issue.Number == 42
inGL, errGL := toolio.Resolve(ctx, "https://gitlab.com/group/sub/project/-/merge_requests/99", nil, client)
assert errGL == nil && inGL.Kind == toolio.KindIssue
assert inGL.Issue.Repo.Owner == "group/sub" && inGL.Issue.Repo.Name == "project" && inGL.Issue.Number == 99 && inGL.Issue.IsPullRequest == true

criteria.condition: Resolve receives an issue URL when the provided issuex.Client is nil
criteria.action: reject the request with an error indicating no forge client is configured
criteria.contract: returns an error stating cannot read issue: no forge client configured

setup: a valid issue URL string "https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/10"

_, err := toolio.Resolve(ctx, "https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/10", nil, nil)

criteria.condition: forge.ReadIssue returns an HTTP 404 not found error and forge.Authenticated() is false
criteria.action: return an error wrapping the underlying failure and stating that the repository or issue may be private and require credentials
criteria.contract: returns an error annotating that credentials may be required for private access

criteria.condition: forge.ReadIssue succeeds for a recognized issue reference
criteria.action: set ref.IsPullRequest to true if thread.Issue.IsPR is true, truncate the rendered thread at MaxInputBytes, and return an Input with Kind KindIssue, Origin ref.URL(), Body set to truncated text, Truncated set to cut or thread.Truncated, Issue pointing to ref, and Thread pointing to thread
criteria.contract: ref.IsPullRequest is set to true reflecting thread.Issue.IsPR; Input.Kind is KindIssue and Input.Origin is ref.URL(); Input.Body is truncated at MaxInputBytes with truncation marker; Input.Truncated is set to true and Input.Issue and Input.Thread are non-nil pointers

setup: an issuex.Client returning an IssueThread where Issue.IsPR is true and body exceeds MaxInputBytes
check.pseudocode:
client := &mockClient{thread: issuex.IssueThread{Issue: issuex.Issue{IsPR: true, State: "open"}, Comments: makeLargeComments()}}
in, err := toolio.Resolve(ctx, "https://github.com/org/repo/issues/5", nil, client)
assert err == nil
assert in.Kind == toolio.KindIssue
assert in.Issue.IsPullRequest == true
assert in.Origin == in.Issue.URL()
assert in.Truncated == true

assert strings.Contains(in.Body, "truncated at")
